label: 🕸 Network graph
description: Force-directed network plot from a (source, target, value) edge list. Use for fraud rings, social-network analysis, supply-chain dependencies. Different from chord_diagram (which assumes source + target draw from the same set); network_graph supports arbitrary node sets and reveals communities via spring layout.

valueColumn.label: Edge weight column (optional)
valueColumn.help: If set, edge widths are proportional to this value.

communityDetection.label: Color nodes by community
communityDetection.help: Run greedy modularity community detection and color each node by its assigned community.
